title: workflow/1.0/start
description: Starts a workflow instance from a template, bound to the connection it arrives on. The thread id is the instance id. Answered with a status (state pending while queued), or a problem-report; an unknown template makes the processor send fetch-template on the same thread first. (didcomm.org workflow/1.0)

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender.

from.description: Sender DID. REQUIRED when the message is authcrypted.

thid.description: Thread id; the id of the message that started the thread.

instance_id.description: The workflow instance's id. The thread id MUST equal it.

context.description: Initial context. A vault-backed field is a {"$ref": {vault_id, doc_id, digest}} pointer.

connection_id.description: Ignored: the processor binds the instance to the inbound connection. The definition says not to send it; @ajna-inc/workflow does.

template_hash.description: Integrity hint; sent as prefer_hash in a resulting fetch-template.

participants.description: Participants by role key (issuer, holder, ...). The processor fills issuer and holder from the connection when missing.
